reviewItem.question: Does "Storage version of `clustersecretstores.external-secrets.io` changes v1beta1 → v1" mean a change to migration:external-secrets|name=clustersecretstores-storage-version-migration (migration-required)?

proposed.statement: From chart 0.15.0 to 0.16.0, the storage version of clustersecretstores.external-secrets.io moves from v1beta1 to v1. Existing ClusterSecretStore objects need a storage version migration and a status.storedVersions update before a later release removes v1beta1.
